info.name: Microchip Technology — Verified Feeds (No Key Required)
info.description: Comprehensive collection of verified, live-tested Microchip Technology RSS feeds. Requires zero authentication. Directly consumed by PartPilot's apps/feed service and adapter-pcn-parser to monitor datasheets, silicon errata, new product announcements, and active MPNs.

request.description: Monitors newly released and revised Microchip datasheets. Each item provides the MPN, description, and direct link to the canonical PDF datasheet on ww1.microchip.com.

response.body:
